aggregateUniqueSubjects.policy: Only approved, content-bound external human-declared judgments enter linguistic metrics. Identities/qualifications/independence are declarations requiring external verification. Unknowns excluded with coverage; descriptive Wilson intervals do not establish independence. Cases/families/documents are counts, not inferred independent observations. AI decisions remain recorded and cannot approve. Existing predictions are unchanged.
